analysis.title: How can I invest in transformational innovation?
key_insights: UBS CIO recommends complementing diversified equity portfolios with targeted exposure to three transformational themes: AI, Power and resources, and Longevity.
UBS estimates overall AI-related capex rises to USD 1.4tr in 2027 and expects AI spending of USD 1.0tr this year, with agentic AI supporting the next phase.

Elevated expectations, post-midterm policy uncertainty and diverging company outcomes raise single-stock concentration risk in AI. UBS favors balanced exposure across the AI value chain, from select semiconductors and hardware to megacap tech and more defensive areas.

Power and resources demand is supported by data center growth, with annual power and grid sector investment expected to reach USD 3tr by 2030. Opportunities span grid resilience, renewables, nuclear, industrial automation and critical minerals.
US policy shifts, execution risks and project delays may create volatility in Power and resources, but robust pipelines and strong order backlogs support the longer-term outlook.
Data centers could account for up to 9% of total US electricity use by 2035 versus around 4% currently, per Bloomberg New Energy Finance forecasts.
In Longevity, UBS is constructive on obesity treatments as greater supply and lower pricing broaden patient access. It forecasts global GLP-1 revenue growth of 12% per year on average through 2030.

Multiple late-stage trial readouts in cancer, cardio-metabolic conditions and neurology in coming months could be catalysts. UBS estimates the global longevity market could reach USD 8tr by 2030, up from USD 5.3tr in 2023.

Market backdrop: on 20 November the Nasdaq fell 5.3% and the S&P 500 fell 3.7%. The Nasdaq is down 19.8% from its 6 October high, close to bear market territory, and the S&P 500 is in correction, down 11.5%.

sector_views.rationale: AI remains a powerful driver of earnings growth and capex is rising, but UBS favors diversified exposure given concentration and monetization risks.
Electrification and data center demand support investment in power and grid infrastructure, with USD 3tr annual investment expected by 2030.
Obesity drugs and late-stage clinical catalysts support long-term growth, with the global longevity market estimated at USD 8tr by 2030.

risk_factors: Elevated AI expectations and questions on adoption, monetization and returns on capital.
Post-midterm US policy uncertainty and shifting US policy.
Diverging company outcomes that raise single-stock concentration risk.
Execution risks and project delays in power and data center buildout.
Clinical trial outcomes in Longevity could disappoint.
vol_and_positioning: Nasdaq is down 19.8% from its 6 October high, close to bear market territory, and the S&P 500 is down 11.5% in correction territory after the 20 November selloff.
